name: Spaceship 9cee5c6a on 4.8.8
description: A period-6 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 7 to 13 cells, moving 2 lattice steps every 6 generations (c/3), the only surviving 4.8.8 candidate that does not move at c/2. It runs the same way in the 128 rules from B2/S2 to B2578/S25678 and contains no smaller ship. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 11 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
